name: Sword
overview: The Bible presents the sword as both a literal weapon and a powerful symbol of God's judgment and protection. From the flaming sword guarding Eden (Genesis 3:24) to the sword wielded by Gideon as an instrument of the Lord's deliverance (Judges 7:20), Scripture highlights its role in divine authority and warfare. The sword also signifies victory and strength, as seen in David's acceptance of Goliath's sword (1 Samuel 21:9) and the promise of life through the sword in Genesis 27:40. Additionally, the sword embodies God's righteous judgment, sharpened to execute vengeance on enemies (Deuteronomy 32:41), underscoring its dual nature as both protector and instrument of justice.
